# Templates Pack — How to Use

Fill these in as you go. Each one supports a pillar from `typing-website-six-pillar-proof-plan.md`.
**Rule:** set thresholds and decision rules **before** you look at data, and write them in the file.

| File | Pillar | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| `decision-log.md` | All | Day 1, then every decision |
| `weekly-scorecard.md` | All | Every Monday |
| `research-guides.md` | 2, 6 | Interviews, exit interviews, diary study, usability tasks |
| `outreach-and-100-list.md` | 6 | Recruiting your first users and testers |
| `first-run-observation-sheet.md` | 2, 4, 6 | Watching someone use the product the first time |
| `pmf-survey.md` | 2 | Every 4-6 weeks once you have active users |
| `efficacy-study-protocol.md` | 1 | Before the beta efficacy pilot and before the main study |
| `ai-pr-review-checklist.md` | 3 | Every pull request; weekly audit |
| `content-brief-and-audit.md` | 4 | Every content batch |
| `design-brief-and-critique.md` | 4 | Design direction, tests, critiques |
| `privacy-data-map-and-dpia-lite.md` | 5 | Before any data-touching feature; before launch |
| `integrity-test-plan.md` | 5 | Before any public leaderboard |

**Note:** legal and privacy items are working documents, not legal advice. Have a professional review before launch.
